133.description: These tokens represent common character n-grams and subword fragments found in Hindi text.

11.description: This vector represents sequential numbers or integer counting values, primarily clustered around the high 180s.

106.description: This vector represents common subword fragments and prefixes from Hindi text.

125.description: This vector is related to Sanskrit/Indic conjunct consonants and vowel-consonant combinations featuring the halant (virama) sign.

15.description: This feature vector activates on Hindi text segments containing the anusvara diacritic ( ं ).

56.description: This vector represents Hindi vowel signs, standalone vowels, and common conjunct consonant endings used in Devanagari script tokenization.

83.description: These tokens represent consecutive three-digit numbers, primarily in the 190s, along with a Devanagari numeral for 19.

152.description: This feature vector represents common Hindi verb roots, inflections, and auxiliary suffixes used to construct tense and aspect.

0.description: This vector represents Hindi vowel signs and dependent vowel modifiers used in conjunction with consonants.

52.description: This vector activates for common Hindi pronouns, adjectives, and modifiers related to size, comparison, and possession.
